Bug_Title: "@Controller" classes that use "@SessionAttributes" must call "setComplete" on their "SessionStatus" objects
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by having a @Controller class annotated with @SessionAttributes without calling setComplete() on the SessionStatus object in any of its request mapping methods.
